description: NaLiB₂(NH₅)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine H atoms. There are a spread of Na-H bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.66 Å. Li is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three N and three H atoms. There are a spread of Li-N bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.21 Å. There are a spread of Li-H bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.17 Å. There are two inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to one N and three H atoms. The B-N bond length is 1.56 Å. All B-H bond lengths are 1.24 Å. In the second B site, B is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to one N and three H atoms. The B-N bond length is 1.55 Å. There are two shorter (1.24 Å) and one longer (1.25 Å) B-H bond length. There are two inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Li, one B, and two H atoms. Both N-H bond lengths are 1.02 Å. In the second N site, N is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to one Li, one B, and two H atoms. There is one shorter (1.02 Å) and one longer (1.03 Å) N-H bond length. There are ten inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the third H site, H is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, and one B atom. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one B atom. In the fifth H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na and one B atom. In the sixth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the seventh H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the eighth H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one Li, and one B atom. In the ninth H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na and one B atom. In the tenth H site, H is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, and one B atom.
